messages:
maya-fin: Heads-up: revops asked us to run a mid-tier floor pilot next week. Need signoffs for opt-in process, GL tagging, and legal exclusions. Can we confirm flow?

sam-billing: Outline please. I assume preview -> small billed pilot -> expand? Also need to know what to write into invoice_meta so accounting can split revenue.

maya-fin: Correct. Flow: 1) AM opt-in window (48h) 2) 50-account dry billed pilot for 7 days 3) metric check (disputes, churn, support volume) 4) expand to 500 if green. invoice_meta.pilot_tag should be pmidfloor-2026-04.

ara-salesops: AM opt-in: we'll publish a sheet with am_owned boolean and allow AMs to opt their whitelist. Lock the sheet 24h before pilot. Only AM-approved customers go into the floor arm.

june-cs: CS wants the exact customer-facing phrasing for billing questions. We'll avoid language like "price increase"; use "billing alignment pilot". Also need an escalation playbook and #pilot-floor Slack tag.

nina-legal: Two big checks: (A) exclude annual/committed-price contracts by default; (B) confirm any notice complies with contract change clauses. Provide contract_status and renewal_date in export.

omar-revops: For revenue recognition we need separate GL mapping for pilot charges vs baseline. Sam, can you map invoice_meta.pilot_tag to rev_account pm_pilot_revenue to avoid commingling? Also we need to capture deferred revenue delta per customer.

sam-billing: I can add invoice_meta.pilot_tag and set revenue_account=pm_pilot_revenue. Preview mode will set preview_flag=true and not emit charge events. For billed pilot revenue_account will be configurable. No auto-prorate on pilot.

zane-eng: I'll implement runtime gating: ff:midtier-floor-pilot; accepts arms=control|floor and pilot_tag. Preview=true will run through billing preview pipeline only. ETA: 36 hours.

maya-fin: Metrics we require after 7d: net additional revenue (gross pilot uplift minus chargebacks), dispute_count_7d, churn_delta_30d (proj), CS_tickets_delta. If dispute_count_7d > 2% abort.

ara-salesops: AM opt-in asks: accept only AM_ok=true. We'll also filter out accounts with last_invoice_dispute_90d > 1. Sam include that column.

june-cs: Add a canned support response: "We're running a temporary billing alignment pilot to better match usage patterns. Your invoice preview shows an alternate billing scenario — no charges have been applied yet / charges may apply during pilot." I'll post the template.

sam-billing: Export fields I'll include: customer_id, am_owned, contract_status, renewal_date, monthly_spend_est, last_invoice_dispute_90d, support_tier, billing_currency. Will tag AMs in the sheet for sign-off.

nina-legal: Please route any AM-opted-in account that has negotiated discounts to me. If a manual discount exists, exclude unless legal & revops approve.

omar-revops: Also add a flag in the export: revenue_hold=true|false. If revenue_hold=true we'll not recognize pilot revenue until manual review.

sam-billing: Noted. I'll add revenue_hold and pilot_bucket columns.

maya-fin: Timeline: sam export today -> AM opt-in sheet live by 10am tomorrow -> legal checks by noon -> eng flag live by EOD -> 48h preview -> 50-account billed pilot starts Fri -> measurement over weekend -> review Mon.

zane-eng: Will prioritize the flag. Also adding a debug endpoint for preview runs so CS can fetch invoice_preview details per-customer.

june-cs: Standby rotation: I'll put two folks on morning/evening shifts this week of the pilot. Post the #pilot-floor tag when we go live.

ara-salesops: I'll circulate the AM opt-in link and lock at T-minus 24h.

maya-fin: Decision rules recapped: exclude annuals & negotiated discounts, remove accounts with >1 dispute in 90d, abort if dispute_rate_7d > 2% or unexpected support spike > 50% vs baseline.

sam-billing: Export started, will DM the sheet and tag legal/AMs. I'll also preconfigure pilot_tag mapping.

maya-fin: Thanks team. I'll draft the AM opt-in email and CS copy and drop them here for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
